title: Namibia calculator readiness research — Batch 32
executive_summary: Reviewed Namibia's NAB 2024/25 annual report and FAO's 28 August 2026 outlook; added distinction between six agronomic production zones and 14 administrative regions. Crop-specific final outputs, region crosswalk, farmer-paid input costs, enterprise budgets and calculator tests remain incomplete.

sources.use: 2024/25 marketed grain volumes by six zones, selected zone-level yields, annual floor-price averages.
2026 aggregate cereal estimate 155,000 tonnes; commercial share nearly 80%; communal cereal output below average; improved livestock body conditions; Zambezi locust/flood losses.

sources.publisher: Namibia Ministry of Urban and Rural Development

safeguards: NAB agronomic zones are not administrative regions.
Marketed grain volumes are not total production or yield.
Annual floor-price averages are not dated farm-gate transaction prices.
FAO aggregate cereal production is not apportioned among individual crops.
Namibia remains directory-only; original 10 active countries are not changed.
remaining_work: Extract NSA 2026 agriculture bulletin tables and final 2025/26 census outputs.
Verify NAB zone-level yield observations and map agronomic zones to administrative regions.
Obtain current dated producer prices and farmer-paid input costs by region and production system.
Build representative irrigated and rainfed budgets and calculator test cases.
